docs.gettingStarted: Install @acme/design-system, wrap your app with AcmeProvider, import the default theme, and use documented components before creating custom UI.
docs.codingGuidelines: Use Acme components for all standard UI. Reach for tokens before raw CSS. Document deviations and add accessibility checks for every new screen.
docs.colorUsage: Use semantic color tokens for text, surfaces, borders, and status. Reserve brand accent colors for primary actions and key highlights.
docs.typographyUsage: Use typography tokens for page titles, section headers, body copy, captions, and labels. Avoid one-off font sizes.
